messages:
Ana (eng-platform): Quick sync: I want to standardize a tiny metric set from runtime so console + infra can build dashboards/alerts for both Hosted and Dedicated GPU pools. Focus: SM occupancy, gpu_memory_used, queue_depth, + KV cache size. Thoughts?

Kevin (eng-runtime): We can export those. Caveats: per-kernel SM sampling is noisy; recommend 10s sampling with 1m rollups. We can add an optional model_hash label but that raises cardinality.

Sara (console): UX needs: pool-level heatmap (p95 occupancy), allocation drilldowns with queue-depth sparklines, and a simple alert builder. Important labels: pool_id, pool_type (hosted/dedicated), region, allocation_id, model_hash (hashed ok), quant_flag. Keep tenant identifiers out.

Mike (infra): Agree on label set but emphasize cardinality limits. Runtime emits two streams: full-res (10s) with low-cardinality labels, and sampled per-model stream at 1m with model_hash. We'll run downsampling to keep Thanos/CH sane. Also need to know expected series rate.

Julia (eng-ml): Please include cached_kv_bytes and a quantization label (q4/q8/none). For detecting regressions after rollouts we need short-lived per-model series (24-72h) with model_hash to analyze memory/latency changes.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Proposed metric names + example snippets:

```
# gauge: average SM occupancy percent over sample interval
redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy_percent{pool_id="hosted-prod-1",pool_type="hosted",region="us-west-2",allocation_id="alloc-42"} 63.4

# gauge: GPU memory in bytes
redwood_gpu_memory_bytes_used{pool_id="hosted-prod-1",pool_type="hosted"} 5872345600

# gauge: queued inference requests
redwood_gpu_queue_depth{pool_id="dedicated-a",allocation_id="alloc-9"} 5

# gauge: KV cache bytes used
redwood_gpu_kv_cache_bytes{pool_id="hosted-prod-1",model_hash="m_ab12"} 12451200
```

We'll attach a sample_rate label when emitting sampled model-level streams.

Mike (infra): Storage/ingest note: telemetry-bot shows ~1200 GPUs -> ~11k series/sec at 10s resolution if we include allocation_id. We'll keep 7d full-res and 90d 1m rollups in ClickHouse. I'll validate costs and post numbers.

telemetry-bot: [system] Estimate: +260GB/month at 1m retention for these metrics (approx). Ingest spike risk when many allocations flurry during rollouts.

Sara (console): Panel query examples requested. Kevin, can you propose PromQLs? For the heatmap we want p95 occupancy over last 5m per pool. For the queue widget we want current sum by pool.

Kevin (eng-runtime): Example queries: 
- p95 occupancy per pool: quantile_over_time(0.95, redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy_percent[5m])
- active queue depth per pool (instant): sum by (pool_id) (redwood_gpu_queue_depth)
- rolling kv bytes by model (1m): avg_over_time(redwood_gpu_kv_cache_bytes[1m])

Julia (eng-ml): For rollout detection: also add a simple derived metric: redwood_model_memory_delta_pct comparing last 1h vs previous 24h for hashed models (only emitted for 24-72h post-rollout). Runtime/console can collaborate on how to signal the "recent rollout" window.

Ana (eng-platform): Implementation plan suggestion:
1) Runtime (Kevin) implements exporters with labels: pool_id, pool_type, region, allocation_id, optional model_hash, quant_flag, sample_rate.
2) Infra (Mike) routes high-cardinality streams to ClickHouse at 1m and keeps 10s low-card stream in Prometheus/Thanos for 7d.
3) Console (Sara) builds heatmap + allocation drilldown panels and provides panel queries.
4) ML (Julia) provides annotation rules for rollout windows and model_hash legal/opt-out policy.

Mike (infra): We should gate the model_hash emission behind a per-tenant opt-in (compliance). Also, we'll need a migration doc for existing dashboards to move from ad-hoc metrics to these canonical names.

Sara (console): I'll wireframe heatmap + drilldown tomorrow and include sample queries. Can we also add a cost ribbon that estimates extra vGPU hours if occupancy > 70% for 24h? That helps capacity planning.

Kevin (eng-runtime): No blockers. I'll start a branch and a small shim that can add sample_rate labels and toggle model_hash. Will send example metric formats in PR.

Julia (eng-ml): +1. Also recommend tagging metrics with quant_flag so console can filter quantized vs full-precision behavior.

Ana (eng-platform): I'll draft an RFC that contains: metric names + labels, sampling + rollup policy, retention and storage mapping, console mockups + queries, rollout/canary plan (dedicated pools first). Assign owners in the RFC. Target: PR by Friday EOD.

Mike (infra): I'll post ingest & cost sims tomorrow and create the ClickHouse table schema once we agree on labels.

telemetry-bot: [system] Action items logged: create RFC, infra sizing, console wireframes, runtime exporter branch.

Ana (eng-platform): Thanks all. If anyone has strong objections to the metric names or labels, reply here within 24h. Otherwise I'll open the RFC and tag owners. :thumbsup:
